about.title: About Me
about.paragraph1: I'm a developer with over three years of professional experience in IT and systems maintenance. At Leader Group I looked after hardware, networking and databases for retail systems — both the cashier front line and the back office — across Leader Hypermarket, Leader Mart, Cement Timor, Auto Timor Leste and Lisun Timor.
about.paragraph2: Since 2025 I've been an IT Collaborator in the Software Development department at Viettel Timor, Unipessoal, Lda. (Telemor), one of Timor-Leste's leading telecommunications companies, building real applications used by staff and customers.

queueCase.metaTitle: Visitor and Queue System at DRCCMD 2026
queueCase.metaDescription: Case study: QR badges, phone check-in and a lobby welcome screen for the Díli Regional Cooperative Conference and Ministerial Dialogue 2026 at Palm Spring, Dili.
queueCase.title: Visitor and Queue System
queueCase.lede: Ministers, delegations and guests arrived at Palm Spring at the same time. Instead of a paper list and a long queue, every visitor carried a QR badge — one scan at the door, and the lobby screen welcomed them by name.

items.detail: Díli Regional Cooperative Conference and Ministerial Dialogue 2026

queueCase.leadAlt: The lobby screen reading 08:51, waiting for arrivals, beside the registration desk and its team.
queueCase.leadCaption: 08:51 — the lobby screen, waiting for the first arrivals.
queueCase.problem: A ministerial dialogue means many important guests arriving at once, each one to be checked against the guest list and welcomed properly. A paper list at the door turns that into a queue — and nobody inside knows who has already arrived.
queueCase.stepsIntro: Two paths at the door, one welcome. Visitors already in the system went straight to the scan; everyone else was registered on the spot.

steps.title: Register on the spot
steps.body: At the entrance, the welcome team registers anyone who isn't in the system yet — right there at the desk.
steps.alt: The welcome team at the desk with a visitor, the lobby screen behind them.
steps.caption: The welcome desk at the entrance.

steps.title: The QR ID card
steps.body: Every registered visitor carries an ID card with their own QR code.
steps.alt: Delegates wearing QR ID cards on lanyards.
steps.caption: QR ID cards on lanyards.

steps.title: One scan
steps.body: Registered before the event or a minute ago, everyone meets the same moment: a phone scans the ID card and the visitor is checked in.
steps.alt: A staff member scans a delegate's QR ID card with a phone.
steps.caption: A phone scans the ID card.

steps.title: Welcome on screen
steps.body: The lobby screen greets the visitor by name and photo, then goes back to waiting for the next arrival.
steps.alt: Video: an ID card is scanned and the lobby screen shows “Welcome” with the visitor's name and photo.
steps.caption: Filmed at the event: scan, then welcome.
